manual_os_audit.source_commit: ASR10 manual-to-OS audit as published at QA baseline 6115232

evidence.limitation: The raw original OS inventory is not in Git. This derives records only from the published normalized audit. A label-only candidate is never promoted to a semantic mapping.

classification_policy.exact_match: normalized label identity is evidence of a label match only; source OS row remains unlinked pending semantic confirmation
classification_policy.composite_field: explicit cursor-selected subfield evidence or a published normalization says one manual heading expands to multiple fields
classification_policy.naming_abbreviation_mismatch: published manual-heading normalization identifies a shared/consolidated OS field
classification_policy.variation_specific_field: explicit VAR field or descriptor identity; no effect-specific control mapping inferred
classification_policy.modulation_field: recognized manual/OS modulation descriptor; destination restrictions remain unverified unless separately evidenced
classification_policy.missing_original_os_capture: the published inventory marks the effect scan deferred or the manual descriptor has no associated field in the published observations; this does not prove the original OS lacks the control
classification_policy.unresolved: published evidence does not establish a reliable relation
